PRESIDENT'S ORDER 3 OF 1984
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 3 OF 1984
GIFT TAX
(AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, 14th June, 1984]
The following Order made by the
President on the 14th June, 1984, is hereby published for general information
:-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Gift Tax (Amendment) Order,
1984.
(2) It shall come into force on
the first day of July, 1984.
2. Amendment of Act XIV of
1963.-The following amendment shall be made in the Gift Tax Act, 1963 (XIV
of 1963), namely :--
(1) in section 5,-
(a) in
subsection (1), for clause (iv) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(iv) to
any institution or fund established for a religious or charitable purpose which
is approved under section 15-D of the Income-tax Act, 1922, or under section 14
or section 47 of the Income-tax Ordinance, 1979.'' ; and
(b) in
subsection (2), for the word "five" the word "twenty" shall
be sub stituted." ;
(2) after section 13, the
following new section shall be inserted, namely :--
"13-A. Payment
of tax on the basis of return.-Every person who is required under this Act
to furnish a return of gifts shall pay the tax, payable on the basis of such
return, on or before the date on which he is so required to furnish such
return." ; and
(3) section 32-A shall be
re-numbered as subsection (2) of that section and, before subsection (2)
re-numbered as aforesaid, the following new sub. section (1) shall be
inserted,. namely :-
"(1) Where
an assesses fails to pay the amount of tax payable by him under section 13-A,
he shall, without prejudice to his liability under any other provisions of law,
be liable to pay an additional amount of tax equal to fifteen per cent per
annum of the amount as was not paid from the date it first became payable to
the date of payment mentioned in the notice of demand under section 31 or the date
on which the tax is actually paid, whichever is earlier."
